summary: Emitted the specific bounded render classification on the single artwork-boundary log line. ArtworkGenerationCoordinator.LogOutcome now appends a private DescribeClassification(result) qualifier between the bounded outcome and the generic reason: ' (PassThroughReason=<RenderPassThroughReason>)' for a pass-through result, ' (FailureReason=<RenderFailureReason>)' for a render failure, ' (SourceFailureReason=<ArtworkSourceReadFailureReason>)' for a source-read failure, and an empty string when the result carries no classification (published, no source, blocked, cancelled, publication-not-completed), so those records stay byte-identical to the pre-task shape. The value is a bounded enum named by its enum kind, so the three cases are distinguishable and no raw exception message, provider payload, path, credential, or other unbounded value is reachable. NoFittingBadge (ADR-024) is owned by task 20.1 and was not added. tests/ArrTags.Tests/LogRedactionTests.cs adds four theories over the six verbosity levels (24 cases) covering a pass-through reason, a render failure, a source-read failure, and a no-classification NoSource result; every case asserts no sentinel appears.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The artwork log line emits the specific bounded PassThroughReason, FailureReason, or SourceFailureReason when present.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: DescribeClassification emits ' (PassThroughReason=<value>)', ' (FailureReason=<value>)', or ' (SourceFailureReason=<value>)' and LogOutcome interpolates it between {result.Outcome} and {result.Reason} (src/ArrTags/Artwork/ArtworkGenerationCoordinator.cs). LogRedactionTests.ArtworkLogEmitsTheBoundedPassThroughClassification asserts 'completed with RenderPassThrough (PassThroughReason=NoMetadata):', ArtworkLogEmitsTheBoundedFailureClassification asserts 'completed with RenderFailed (FailureReason=DecodeFailed):', and ArtworkLogEmitsTheBoundedSourceFailureClassification asserts 'completed with SourceUnavailable (SourceFailureReason=Unreadable):' on the captured record at the levels where the Information line is enabled.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The classifications remain bounded and secret-free and are covered by redaction tests.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The emitted values are the enum members of the bounded RenderPassThroughReason, RenderFailureReason, and ArtworkSourceReadFailureReason types plus fixed label text; no free text from the reader/renderer is interpolated. The four new theories run at all six verbosity levels and each asserts AssertNoSentinel over the captured records. The source-failure drive uses a FailedSourceArtworkReader whose raw reason carries the new SourceDetailSentinel; the sentinel is added to AllSentinels, so the test fails if the reader's detail (rather than only the bounded enum) reaches the log.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Also assert the classification is not emitted (or is empty/absent) when there is no classification.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: DescribeClassification returns string.Empty when all three fields are null. ArtworkLogOmitsTheClassificationWhenTheResultCarriesNone drives a valid request with an absent source (NoSource) and asserts the record ends with 'completed with NoSource: The image surface has no source artwork to render.' and contains none of 'PassThroughReason=', 'FailureReason=', or 'SourceFailureReason='. Probe B showed this case fails if a default classification is emitted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Phase 15 acceptance (F8 half): the bounded classification is emitted when present; the classifications remain bounded and secret-free; redaction tests cover them.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented and tested as above. The other half of the phase-15 criterion - the ADR-020 clause 4 amendment, the canonical documentation, the logging security review, and the F8 resolution - remains owned by task 15.4 per the task scope boundary and is untouched.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The change is compatible with ADR-020 clause 4 as amended by ADR-026.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Only bounded enums and fixed label text are added to the log message; the subject threading, the item-id fallback, and the directory/full-path exclusion from ADR-026 are unchanged. The new emission contains no API key, webhook secret, SecretLease value, secret header, request/response body, provider payload, mutable PluginConfiguration, directory, or full path, and no sentinel appears in the captured records.

interpretations.question: The exact message shape for the emitted classification.
interpretations.chosen: A parenthesized qualifier ' (Kind=Value)' appended immediately after the bounded outcome and before the existing ': <reason>' text (for example 'completed with RenderPassThrough (PassThroughReason=NoMetadata): The render passed through; the current artwork is preserved.').
interpretations.basis: The design requirement keeps the message shape otherwise consistent with the existing line and the ADR-026 subject; the codebase already uses parenthesized bounded context (for example the metadata-read-failure '(ProviderKind)' and '(Code (Retryability))' forms); naming the enum kind is required to distinguish a pass-through from a failure and from a source-read failure.
interpretations.impact: Log text only. Task 15.4 owns documenting the exact emitted shape; this is an implementation-level format choice and does not persist or change any semantic.

interpretations.question: How many classifications are emitted when more than one reason field is non-null.
interpretations.chosen: At most one, resolved in the order pass-through -> failure -> source failure, matching the enum kind the result's factory sets.
interpretations.basis: ArtworkGenerationResult's factories set exactly one of PassThroughReason, FailureReason, or SourceFailureReason (Success/NoSource/Blocked/BlockedByPublication/Cancelled/PublicationNotCompleted set none); the acceptance criterion names the three alternatives with 'or'.
interpretations.impact: Log text only; a result cannot currently carry two classifications, so no case is dropped.

interpretations.question: What is emitted when the result carries no classification.
interpretations.chosen: Nothing: the qualifier is the empty string, so the record is byte-identical to the pre-task message for published, no-source, blocked, cancelled, and publication-not-completed outcomes.
interpretations.basis: The requirement allows the classification to be empty/absent when there is none and requires the establishments to remain bounded; adding a placeholder would be new, unrequested log content.
interpretations.impact: Log text only; existing assertions on those records (subject and redaction) are unaffected.

known_limitations: The classification qualifier is emitted only on the Information-level artwork-boundary record and is gated by the plugin log verbosity: at Off, Error, and Warning no artwork record is emitted at all, so the classification is not visible at those levels. This is the existing ADR-020 gating behavior, not changed by this task.

Limitation F8 remains open until task 15.4. Exact behavior: the shipped code now emits the bounded classification, while docs/limitations/open.md F8 and docs/architecture/12-performance-and-operational-limits.md still state that the specific classification is retained on the result but not emitted. Consequence: for the interval between this task and 15.4 the canonical documentation understates the shipped behavior; task 15.4 owns the reconciliation and the ADR-020 clause 4 amendment note.

The ADR-024 NoFittingBadge pass-through reason is not implemented or emitted here. Exact behavior: a non-empty layout-empty render currently reports the existing reason it maps to until task 20.1 adds NoFittingBadge; the emitted qualifier will then carry that new enum member automatically because DescribeClassification reads the result's PassThroughReason. Basis: the task scope boundary assigns NoFittingBadge to Phase 20 (task 20.1).
